recipe.title: Gingerbread men
recipe.notes: This is a Chelsea Sugar recipe.

method.s: Mix flour, baking soda, ginger and sugar. Rub in butter until mix resembles fine breadcrumbs.
Mix in egg and golden syrup. Add some more flour until mix is not too sticky – it should be a relatively firm dough.
Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out to 5 mm between baking paper, refrigerate again for a while, then use a cookie cutter to cut figures out.
Bake (not fan forced) for 12–16 minutes at 180 deg C. Leave on tray for five minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool.

recipe.title: Royal icing
recipe.notes: This is a Chelsea Sugar recipe.

i.n: egg white, lightly beaten until frothy
icing sugar (start with a little less, and add as needed)

method.s: Mix egg white, lemon juice and icing sugar. Once the icing sugar is mostly mixed in, add food colouring if desired.
Transfer to piping bag (a snap-lock bag with the corner cut off works well) and pipe onto cooled gingerbread, then stick lollies on.
